name: Cryptic crossword No 21,783
preamble: Except for 1,5 across (which is normal) clues to the pairs of across answers have been run together and either part may come first. Before entering each across answer in the grid, a consecutive pair of letters must be swapped with its counterpart. (Perhaps the 9 has been at work!) Indications of solutions made up of multiple or hyphenated words has been suppressed for the Across clues. Down clues and answers are normal.

clue.text: Where some learn with weight planet loses temperature, retaining only a little heat

indicators.note: to retain is to keep hold of, so the cooling word holds the small piece of heat inside it

blocks.note: a gram is a unit of weight
the red planet
something that loses temperature cools
just the opening letter of heat

explanation.surface: A student weighed down by a planet that is cooling off, keeping only a scrap of warmth.
explanation.walkthrough: This is the normal clue for the whole of 1 and 5 across. Before entry GRAMMAR's MM and SCHOOLS' OO trade places, the millennium bug of the preamble writing 2000 (MM) as 00, so 1 holds the first seven letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Selective secondary schools in Britain are institutions where pupils study, so they are places where some learn.
